identity: A sturdy leather belt and powered air purifying respirator blower designed for exploring the apocalyptic wasteland.  On one side hangs an archaic dagger sheath.  The other side has three pouches made to snugly and securely hold 26-round PA md. 68 box magazines, although anything that size or smaller will fit.  Mounted to the back is a spartan PAPR blower, shielded in plastic, with connections for a bionic interface.  If loaded with a filter and paired with a PAPR mask this will protect from all manner of post-apocalyptic environmental threats.  The blower is active and draining power.  Activate it to turn it off.

entries.developer_comments:
~ NPC dialogue line
~ Well, correct, these days we look a lot alike, being cyborgs and all.
But you speak normal English for this Earth, not Anglic like me.  Lower
chance they mistake us for the Enemy, or something like that.
identity: Well an' surely, these days ye an' ol' Rubik look near alike, what with the whole cyborgin' an' all.  But ye parley THEIR, or rather YOUR Anglic, not mine.  Less chance they wrongly ken us for mates o' the Enemy or summit.

entries.developer_comments: ~ Description of mutation 'Dancers in the Endless Dark'
identity: The Fair Folk dance across realities, avoiding the notice of the vast and timeless forces that overshadow existence.  This glamour will protect you from a variety of deleterious otherworldly afflictions.  It must be applied before exposure.
